query:
SELECT message_ts AS "message_ts!",
               content,
               is_command,
               chatter_login,
               chatter_id
        FROM twitch_chat_messages
        WHERE message_ts >= $1
          AND LOWER(streamer_login) = $2
          AND (chatter_login IS NULL OR chatter_login = '' OR (LOWER(chatter_login) <> ALL($3) AND LOWER(chatter_login) !~ '^justinfan[0-9]+$'))
